First release of **Home** — a start page for your homelab: cards for every site in Nginx Proxy Manager, your own sites, favorites and search in one place.

## Highlights

- **Sites from NPM** — reads a local `database.sqlite` (read-only) and/or remote Nginx Proxy Manager instances via their REST API.
  The `meta` field with DNS provider keys is never read.
- **Live updates** — changes in NPM, settings, favorites and custom sites appear without reloading the page (Server-Sent Events).
- **Search** — a search bar focused on page load, with a choice of search engine (Google, Yandex, DuckDuckGo, Bing, Startpage and custom ones);
  typing filters cards, `Enter` searches the web or opens a typed address.
- **Custom sites and favorites** — sites that are not in NPM, and stars on cards; stored on the server, the same on every device.
- **Site icons** — resolved on the server: `<link rel="icon">`, web manifest, `/favicon.ico`, data URIs and SVG;
  if the public address is not reachable from the server, the icon is fetched from the NPM backend directly. Cached.
- **Secrets in OpenBao** — remote NPM logins and passwords and the admin password are stored only in OpenBao (KV v2, AppRole).
- **In-app settings** — NPM sources with connection checks, search engines, custom sites, admin password change.
- **UI** — dark theme, animations, collapsible menu, grid and list views, responsive layout. The interface is in Russian.
- No dependencies: Python 3 stdlib + vanilla JS.

## Docker image

| Image | Platforms |
|---|---|
| `ghcr.io/sbrw-evc/home:1.0.0` | linux/amd64, linux/arm64 |

Tags `1.0` and `latest` point to the same image.

## Installation

```bash
curl -L https://github.com/sbrw-evc/Home/releases/download/v1.0.0/home-1.0.0-deploy.tar.gz | tar xz
cd home-1.0.0
cp .env.example .env          # NPM_DATA_DIR — the data directory of your local NPM
./openbao/setup.sh            # OpenBao next to Home (optional if you have your own)
docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.openbao.yml up -d
```

See the [installation guide](https://github.com/sbrw-evc/Home/wiki/Installation) for details.

Requirements: Docker 24+ with Compose v2.
